messages.subject: Re: line size and others...
parts:
Hi

simply you can do by

ggplot(data = coppo, aes(dia,size=l_size)) + geom_line(aes(y = a1)) +
geom_line(aes(y = a2)) + geom_line(aes(y = a3))

another solution is probably better

coppo2<-melt(coppo, id="dia")
ggplot(data=coppo2, aes(x=dia,y=value,group=variable))+geom_line(size=l_size)

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: line size and others...
parts:
On Wed, Sep 29, 2010 at 4:02 AM, Alfredo <alfre...@gmail.com> wrote:
Thanks,

now is ok, but I can't show the legend...

tabella <- melt(tabella,id="dia")

ggplot(data = tabella, aes(x=dia, y=value, group=variable)) +
geom_line(size=0.3, colour=tabella$variable)

In the geom_line() call, you've *set* both size and colour; if variable has more than one value, you should have gotten an error message to that effect. You need to map colour with aes:

    geom_line(aes(colour = variable), size = 0.3)

and then you should get a colour legend. Legends are associated with aesthetics, and you define aesthetics with aes().

HTH,
Dennis

and the legend disappears...


Alfredo
